record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: RATTATA and RATICATE declare AGILITY (passive NONE in the catalog). Other units are not covered.
record.summary: Self buff, no target and no damage: the caster's speed stat is raised by a requested 10/20/30/60 (by stars; 10 for RATTATA 1 star, 20 for RATICATE 2 stars) through addSpeed with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag. A held Big Eater Belt first multiplies the requested value by 1.25 (rounded down to an integer); then the value is multiplied by (1 + AP/100) and by critPower when the cast crit; the result is added to speed, which is clamped between 0 and 300 (MAX_SPEED). The buff is applied to the combat entity only (permanent false) and the default ability animation is suppressed (preventDefaultAnim true: nothing is broadcast). Executed on a caster with speed 50: 1 star 60, 2 stars 70; a Belt takes 10 -> 12 first (62); AP 25 gives 12.5 and the stored speed is not rounded (62.5); the clamp stops at 300.

targeting.note: requiresTarget is false so the cast does not wait for a target in range; the target argument is typed null. How casting is triggered otherwise was not read.

effects.scaling: requested boost x Big Eater Belt 1.25 (rounded down, only if the caster holds BIG_EATER_BELT) x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false). Twist Band does not apply: the value is positive and the caster is on its own team.
effects.resolution: Requested = table value; applied change = the scaled value, but speed ends at clamp(speed + value, 0, 300), so the change is smaller when the caster is near 300. The claims are limited to the ordinary bound units (RATTATA, RATICATE, no passive). A MELMETAL-passive entity (not a bound unit) would delegate to addAttack(0.5 x the Belt-adjusted value, self, 1, crit), which applies AP / crit with Math.round and a second Belt pass and leaves speed unchanged (executed: ATK +5, +7 with a Belt). Applies to the combat entity only; the board Pokémon keeps its base speed.

buffs.duration: none found in this strategy: permanent for the rest of the fight unless something else changes it

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 30 and 60 entries (3 stars and 4+ stars / fallback) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes. maxPP 100 and range 1 for both.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast adds again (stacking) until the 300 cap; nothing is removed by this strategy.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: speed +10 (RATTATA) / +20 (RATICATE). Requested value passes Big Eater Belt (x1.25 down) and AP/crit scaling; applied change is bounded by the 0..300 speed clamp. No damage, no heal, no status.

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (addSpeed, the Belt and Twist helpers, MELMETAL delegation) and the real AgilityStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_B1); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (caster speed 50): the values above, the suppressed animation, the clamp and the MELMETAL delegation.
